caption:
A tiny kitten knight stands up to a giant dragon to protect its egg. 🐉

Seedance 2.5 made this whole fantasy short feel like a movie.
prompt:
use seedance 2.5 for this

VIDEO PROMPT — 25 seconds · 16:9 landscape · photorealistic live-action fantasy short: real fur and scales, cinematic anamorphic look, shallow depth of field, volumetric light; cold blue-grey blizzard grade for the first half, shifting to warm golden sunrise in the second half · camera feel: epic, low ground-level angles that make the kitten tiny and the dragon colossal, slow push-ins and one long pull-back · pacing: tense opening, emotional middle, big action beat, tender ending, 13 shots, no dialogue

CHARACTERS (identical in every shot):
- KITTEN KNIGHT: a tiny kitten with long, fluffy golden-cream fur, a round face, enormous round dark hazel eyes, a small pink nose and white whiskers. A pink satin bow tied at the base of its left ear (signature, visible in every shot). Polished silver medieval plate armor over chainmail on its chest, shoulders and front legs, a long flowing ivory-white cape, and a tiny silver sword with a cross-guard held in its right paw.
- GREAT DRAGON: a colossal black dragon, many times bigger than the kitten, with rough black pebbled scales, rows of jagged black spines along its head and back, large curved horns sweeping back, fiery glowing amber eyes, faint ember-orange glow between the scales of its neck, huge black leathery bat wings with hooked claws at the wing joints, enormous clawed forefeet.
- HATCHLING: a baby black dragon about the kitten's size, glossy black scales, small nubby horns and spikes, big round golden-amber eyes, little leathery wings.
- EGG: a large dragon egg, taller than the kitten, its shell pale icy blue-grey with scale-like plates, glowing golden-orange light shining through branching cracks.

LOCATION: ancient frozen ruins in a mountain valley: broken stone pillars and crumbling towers half-buried in deep snow, snow-covered rocks and cliffs, a frozen icy ground. Heavy blizzard at first; later the storm clears into a golden sunrise with pink-orange clouds.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:01.3) — Into the storm. Low ground-level shot facing the kitten as it trudges toward camera through deep snow, cape whipping in the wind, sword low, snowflakes streaming past. MUST SHOW: a gigantic black dragon foot with huge curved talons stamping down into the snow just behind the kitten on the right, kicking up powder. Slow push back.

SHOT 2 (00:01.3-00:02.3) — The blast. Same low angle, closer: a wall of snow explodes behind the kitten from the impact; it flattens down and squeezes its eyes shut, then lifts its head and looks up in alarm. The edge of the glowing egg appears at the right of frame.

SHOT 3 (00:02.3-00:03.9) — The eyes in the blizzard. Low over-the-shoulder shot from behind the kitten (bottom left, cape and bow visible), the glowing cracked egg in the bottom right corner. Through the swirling snow the dragon's huge horned head emerges and lowers toward them, MUST SHOW: two glowing amber eyes and bared teeth. Slow push-in.

SHOT 4 (00:03.9-00:05.0) — Reflection. Extreme close-up of the kitten's face, frost on its whiskers, enormous dark eyes wide with fear; tiny reflections of the dragon's glowing eyes in its pupils. Locked-off, micro push-in.

SHOT 5 (00:05.0-00:05.8) — The stand. Low wide side view on the snow: the kitten (left) steps in front of the egg (center) and raises its tiny sword; the dragon's dark head and neck loom down from above in the background.

SHOT 6 (00:05.8-00:08.6) — The crack. Low shot from behind the kitten at ground level: the kitten (left, seen from behind, cape and bow) touches the egg with its sword tip; one enormous dragon claw rests on the right. MUST SHOW: the golden cracks across the egg glowing brighter and spreading. The dragon lowers its snout slowly down to the top of the egg and stops, surprised. Slow push-in.

SHOT 7 (00:08.6-00:11.0) — Touch. Reverse angle, medium close: the dragon's huge snout touching the top of the brightly glowing egg from the upper left; the kitten on the right, sword lifted, then reaches out and lays its armored paw gently on the shell. Behind them the sky now glows pink-orange with sunrise, glowing embers drift in the air.

SHOT 8 (00:11.0-00:12.5) — Hatching. Close-up: MUST SHOW: the egg shell bursting open in a shower of golden sparks and white shell chunks; the hatchling pushes up out of it, blinks its big golden eyes and looks curiously at the kitten (over-shoulder, kitten's pink bow and fur in the left foreground). Warm golden backlight.

SHOT 9 (00:12.5-00:13.7) — Gratitude. Wide front shot: the colossal dragon, wings half spread, lowers its head right down over the kitten and the hatchling in the snow, nuzzling them gently; kitten seen from behind in its ivory cape. Snowy cliffs behind, cold blue light.

SHOT 10 (00:13.7-00:15.3) — Trust. Extreme close-up: the kitten, eyes closed, presses its cheek softly against the dragon's black pebbled scales, armored paw resting on them, snowflakes on its fur. Locked-off.

SHOT 11 (00:15.3-00:17.3) — Avalanche. Wide low shot: MUST SHOW: a massive avalanche of white snow and ice pouring over the cliffs and rushing toward them from behind. The dragon crouches over the kitten (who clutches the hatchling under its cape at the dragon's feet) and spreads its huge wings wide; the camera pushes in as the snow wave hits.

SHOT 12 (00:17.3-00:19.8) — The shelter. Wide shot as the snow cloud engulfs everything: MUST SHOW: the dragon's wings curved down to the ground on both sides like an arched tent over the kitten and hatchling. Then the powder slowly settles and thins, revealing them safe underneath, warm golden sunlight glowing through the mist.

SHOT 13 (00:19.8-00:25.1) — The bond. Starts as a close-up of the kitten, eyes closed, smiling contentedly as it cradles the sleeping hatchling against its armored chest, pink bow lit by the sun, sunrise flare behind. The camera then makes one long, slow pull-back: first the dragon's dark body appears behind them, then its arched wing against the bright sky, and finally a wide shot of all three together, the great dragon resting with its head lowered beside the tiny kitten on the icy ground among the snowy ruins and stone towers, under a glowing golden sunrise sky with pink clouds. The kitten's ribbon flutters softly in the dragon's breath.

SOUND: no dialogue, no narration. Cinematic orchestral score: low tense strings and drums through the storm, a soft emotional swell at the hatching, a big percussive surge for the avalanche, warm gentle strings at sunrise. Sound effects: howling icy wind, crunching snow, the heavy boom of the dragon's foot, small clinks of armor, deep rumbling dragon breaths, cracking eggshell and a burst of sparks, tiny hatchling chirps, the thunderous roar of the avalanche, then a calm soft exhale and a light breeze at the end.

Consistency: same kitten, armor, cape and pink bow in every shot; photorealistic, no cartoon look, no morphing, no extra limbs, no duplicate characters.
prompt_short: Photorealistic fantasy short, frozen ruins in a blizzard: a tiny golden kitten in silver armor, ivory cape and pink bow guards a glowing dragon egg from a colossal black dragon; it hatches, the dragon shields them from an avalanche, sunrise ending.
